# Site Overview
> MedMethod Direct is a premium virtual medical clinic focused on longevity, hormones, menopause, and medically guided weight loss for women in perimenopause and menopause. All care is physician-led and delivered 100% virtually.

## About
- [About MedMethod Direct](https://medmethoddirect.com/#about)
- Medical Director: Dr. Jumana Al-Deek, DO
- Specialties: Hormone Replacement Therapy, GLP-1 Weight Loss, Menopause Management, Testosterone Therapy for Women, Longevity Medicine
- Services available in: Florida, Virginia, Maryland, Washington DC, Colorado, Arizona

## Services
- [Women's Health Services](https://medmethoddirect.com/#services)
- [Men's Health Services](https://medmethoddirect.com/male#services)
- Compounded medications sourced from FDA-registered 503B outsourcing pharmacies
- FDA-approved brand-name medications also available

## Blog — The MedMethod Direct Journal
- [All Articles](https://medmethoddirect.com/blog)
- Author: Dr. Jumana Al-Deek, DO — Board-certified osteopathic physician
- Topics: Menopause & metabolism, GLP-1 education, Hormone therapy & testosterone, Longevity & healthy aging, Symptoms & identity

### Published Articles
- [Why Does Weight Gain Feel Different in Menopause?](https://medmethoddirect.com/blog/why-weight-gain-feels-different-in-menopause) — Explains the hormonal science behind menopausal belly fat, insulin resistance, and what actually helps. Pillar: Menopause & Metabolism.
- [What Is Food Noise and Why Is It So Common in Midlife?](https://medmethoddirect.com/blog/what-is-food-noise-midlife) — Covers the neurological basis of food noise, its connection to estrogen decline, and how GLP-1 medications address it. Pillar: GLP-1 Education.
- [Semaglutide vs. Tirzepatide: What Women in Midlife Should Know](https://medmethoddirect.com/blog/semaglutide-vs-tirzepatide-women-midlife) — Compares mechanisms, efficacy, side effects, and cost for women in perimenopause and menopause. Pillar: GLP-1 Education.
- [Can Hormone Therapy Help With Weight, Sleep, and Metabolism?](https://medmethoddirect.com/blog/hormone-therapy-weight-sleep-metabolism) — Reviews the evidence for HRT's impact on body composition, sleep quality, and metabolic health. Pillar: Hormone Therapy & Testosterone.
- [You've Been Putting Yourself Last for Years. Here's Why That Has to Change.](https://medmethoddirect.com/blog/putting-yourself-last-has-to-change) — Addresses the emotional and identity dimension of women's health in midlife, with a permission-giving call to action. Pillar: Symptoms & Identity.
